name: OneMillionDirectory

sources.title: OneMillionDirectory homepage - hand-reviewed general web directory since 2005, 67,160 listings
Submit Listing - 3-step flow: category, listing type, details (account required)
Submission Rules - content, popup, parked-domain, and refund policies

conditions: Account required: 'Create Free Account' / sign-in gates the submit flow
Listing types include paid tiers (Basic Plus, Featured, Premium, Article) alongside an implied free/basic type chosen at step 2 — paid submissions are refunded if not approved
Hand-reviewed; acceptance is not guaranteed ('we cannot always accept every submission')
requirements: Accurate, grammatically correct title and description reflecting the site's actual content
Site must not show popups or attempt software installs; must have real content
No empty sites, expired or parked domains
No illegal content, no content unlawful for children, no adult/erotic/escort material
Listings are re-verified: if the linked site dies, expires, or is parked, the listing is suspended (contact them to reactivate; no deletion)
preparation: Business/site name, URL, clean title and description (grammar-checked)
Best-fit category from the 20 top-level categories (Business, Computer, Internet, Shopping, etc.)
Decide the listing type (free/basic vs Basic Plus / Featured / Premium / Article paid tiers)
workflow: Create a free account at https://onemilliondirectory.com/user/register and sign in
Open https://onemilliondirectory.com/submit — Step 1: pick the category
Step 2: choose the listing type (paid tiers named Basic Plus, Featured, Premium, Article)
Step 3: enter listing details and submit
Wait for human review; if a paid listing is declined, payment is refunded
After approval, keep the site healthy — dead/parked links get the listing suspended
watchFor: Post-approval trap: if you later change the site into non-compliant content or let the domain lapse, the paid listing is disabled with NO refund (though reactivation is possible once fixed)
The listing-type step (step 2) is where paid upsells appear — verify which type is free before entering details
General directory — the link is a citation more than qualified SaaS traffic
Featured/Premium listings get homepage and 'Premium Business' visibility that free listings do not
countsAsLive: A public detail page exists at onemilliondirectory.com/detail/<slug>-link-<id> and the listing appears in its category and Latest feed
unknowns: Whether a truly free listing type exists at step 2 and what it includes (page behind account wall)
Whether free-tier links are dofollow (catalog note says follow; unconfirmed)
